questionRule: Questions must be generated from a primary relationship semantic owner and ask for observable interaction evidence, conditions, counterexamples, or context. Generic trait-confirmation questions are forbidden.

interactionPrompts.ELECTROMAGNETIC: Does this full theme become more observable specifically when A and B are together than when each is acting alone?
interactionPrompts.DOMINANCE: When the participant who owns the full channel brings this theme, does it actually set a noticeable interaction pattern, or is the effect weak/context-specific?
interactionPrompts.COMPROMISE: When one participant owns the full channel and the other shares one Gate, where do they experience alignment, adjustment pressure, or clearly different pacing around the same theme?
interactionPrompts.COMPANIONSHIP: Does the shared structure create recognizable familiarity, or do the two participants still express the same structural theme in clearly different ways?
